description: This Java class 'AverageAnglesUtil' is a command line utility for discovering trigger angles in the rusEfi project. It reads a CSV log file, extracts RPM and analog chart data, processes it to compute average angles, and outputs a report.

classes.name: AverageAnglesUtil
classes.description: Main utility class for processing log files and computing average angles.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the utility, takes filename argument and runs the processing.

methods.name: runUtil
methods.description: Processes the specified log file, extracts RPM and analog data, computes averages, and outputs a report.
